name: Knaptons Pumpkin Patch
description: Knaptons Pumpkin Patch grows Raspberries, Apples, Pears, Plums, and Cherries in Rockford, MN. The farm is small, and its seasons run through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
